title: 第 61 章 结局第 60 章 我要跟他对质
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 陈默回到内门之后刚走进院子就看到沈清璇站在门口，她的身边还站着几个师姐妹，而陆瑶正站在一旁不过脸色有些铁青。
“陈默你过来。”沈清璇说道。
当陈默走过去之后看了一眼陆瑶然后明白了，他在心里想着这个女人果然还是来告状了。
“师父找弟子有事。”陈默问道。
“陆瑶说你抢了她的功法可有此事。”沈清璇开口问道。
可陈默却没有说话而是一脸淡然的站在那里，他没有急着否认也没有承认就那么平静的看着陆瑶。
不过他身上散发出的气息已经暴露了一切，那股元婴期的威压虽然收敛了大半但还是若有若无的散发开来。
这时陆瑶的脸色当场就变了，她的眼神一怔双腿都在发抖。
元婴期。
这个陈默居然晋级到了元婴期，这才过去多久他怎么就突破到元婴期了？
这时陆瑶的脑子一片空白整个人都傻了，她瞪大眼睛看着陈默而且嘴唇都哆嗦着一个字都说不出来。
“陈默你到底有没有抢陆瑶的功法，若你是被诬陷的为师一定替你做主。”
当陈默转过头看了陆瑶一眼然后就开口了，他的语气平淡几乎听不出任何情绪。
“陆瑶师姐你说我抢了你的功法，可有什么证据。”陈默问道。
此刻陆瑶张了张嘴正要说话的时候，她看到陈默的眼神中带着一丝威胁的意味。
那种眼神很冷让她的后背一阵发凉，她现在在陈默面前就像是蝼蚁一般。
元婴期的强者要捏死她跟捏死一只蝼蚁没什么区别，当陆瑶想到这里之后全身都在发抖。
“没……没有。”陆瑶结结巴巴的说道。
“是我误会了，陈默师兄没有抢我的功法。”
“是我自己搞错了，对不起是我冤枉了陈默师兄。”
当沈清璇听到这话之后眉头微微皱了一下，她在心里想着这个陆瑶怎么突然改口了。
“你真的确定是误会。”沈清璇问道。
“确定。”陆瑶连忙点头。
“是弟子记错了，弟子不该冤枉陈默师兄还请沈长老恕罪。”
而沈清璇看了她一眼然后摆了摆手，陆瑶如蒙大赦连忙转身就跑出了院子。
跑出去之后她头都不敢回一路狂奔回了外门，回到自己的住处关上门她靠在墙上大口大口的喘着气。
这时她的腿还在发抖，没想到陈默竟然晋级到了元婴期。
只见陆瑶蹲在地上抱着自己的膝盖，而眼泪止自己干不住的往下流。
如今陈默已经晋级到元婴期了，估计她这辈子都不可能报仇了。
现在也只好认命，否则的话得罪了元婴强者恐怕连自己这条命都保不住了
方才陈默站在院子里看着陆瑶跑出去的背影，随后就收回了目光不过的脸上没有什么表情，似乎像什么都没发生过一样。
这时沈清璇看着他眼中也是带着几分疑惑和惊讶，她能清楚的感觉到陈默身上的气息跟之前完全不一样了。
“陈默你晋级到元婴期了。”沈清璇说道。
“是的师父，弟子刚刚有所突破。”
当沈清璇听到这话之后深吸了一口气，她在心里想着这个弟子修炼的速度也太快了。
这才拜入她门下多久就从金丹期突破到了元婴期，这样的天赋在整个青云宗都找不出第二个来吧。
content_en:
After returning to the inner door, Chen Mo just walked into the courtyard and saw Shen Qingxuan standing at the door. There were several junior sisters standing beside her, and Lu Yao was standing aside, but her face was a little livid.
"Chen Mo, come here." Shen Qingxuan said.
When Chen Mo walked over, he glanced at Lu Yao and understood. He thought in his mind that this woman had come to complain after all.
"Master has something to do with his disciple." Chen Mo asked.
"Did Lu Yao say that you stole her skills?" Shen Qingxuan asked.
But Chen Mo didn't speak but stood there with an indifferent expression. He didn't rush to deny or admit and just looked at Lu Yao calmly.
However, the aura exuding from his body had revealed everything. Although the pressure of the Nascent Soul stage had been restrained by most of it, it still spread out vaguely.
At this time, Lu Yao's expression changed on the spot, her eyes were stunned and her legs were shaking.
Nascent Soul stage.
This Chen Mo actually advanced to the Nascent Soul stage. How could he break through to the Nascent Soul stage just a short time ago?
At this time, Lu Yao's mind went blank and she was dumbfounded. She stared at Chen Mo with wide eyes and her lips were trembling, unable to speak a word.
"Chen Mo, did you steal Lu Yao's skills? If you are falsely accused, I will make the decision for you."
When Chen Mo turned his head to look at Lu Yao and then spoke, his tone was flat and almost no emotion could be heard.
"Senior Sister Lu Yao, you said that I stole your skills, do you have any evidence?" Chen Mo asked.
At this moment, when Lu Yao opened her mouth and was about to speak, she saw a hint of threat in Chen Mo's eyes.
The cold look in her eyes sent chills down her back. She was now like an ant in front of Chen Mo.
For a strong person in the Nascent Soul stage to crush her to death was no different than crushing an ant to death. When Lu Yao thought of this, her whole body trembled.
"No...no." Lu Yao stammered.
"I misunderstood. Senior Brother Chen Mo didn't steal my technique."
"I made a mistake myself. I'm sorry that I wronged Senior Brother Chen Mo."
When Shen Qingxuan heard this, she frowned slightly. She was thinking about why Lu Yao suddenly changed her tune.
"Are you really sure it's a misunderstanding?" Shen Qingxuan asked.
"OK." Lu Yao nodded quickly.
"Disciple remembered it wrong. Disciple should not have wronged Senior Brother Chen Mo and asked Elder Shen to forgive me."
Shen Qingxuan glanced at her and waved her hand. Lu Yao immediately turned around and ran out of the yard.
After running out, she didn't dare to look back and ran all the way back to the outer door. When she returned to her apartment and closed the door, she leaned against the wall and gasped for air.
At this time, her legs were still shaking, but she didn't expect that Chen Mo would advance to the Nascent Soul stage.
Lu Yao was seen squatting on the ground holding her knees, and her tears couldn't stop flowing down.
Now that Chen Mo has advanced to the Nascent Soul stage, it is estimated that she will never be able to take revenge in this life.
Now I have no choice but to accept my fate, otherwise I am afraid that if I offend the powerful Nascent Soul, I may not even be able to save my own life.
Just now, Chen Mo stood in the yard and looked at Lu Yao's running figure. Then he looked away, his face expressionless, as if nothing had happened.
At this time, Shen Qingxuan looked at him with some confusion and surprise in her eyes. She could clearly feel that the aura on Chen Mo's body was completely different from before.
"Chen Mo, you have advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage." Shen Qingxuan said.
"Yes, Master, my disciple has just made a breakthrough."
When Shen Qingxuan heard this and took a deep breath, she thought in her heart that this disciple was practicing too fast.
Not long after joining her disciples, he broke through from the Golden Core stage to the Nascent Soul stage. There is no one else with such talent in the entire Qingyun Sect.
